I have always been a fan of the Aliens franchise so I might have begun bias in interest, but genuinely from a game stand point I really enjoy Aliens: Fireteam Elite.  Thus far I have played exclusively with my partner and best friend or solo.  The AI drones you receive when playing Solo are excellent and respond realistically to the various situations presented.  They will get you up if you go down, which is a nice feature, and they are self repairing so you do not have to constantly monitor and heal them.

Now for the negative, I absolutely hate the way the Doctor's first ability (Triage) works.  It is given a limited pool of HP, roughly enough for two players to go from less than 10% health to full or near full.  It is supposed to refill with picking up health packs, but if you have a health pack in your inventory you cannot pick up the new one and thus you cannot refill the Triage ability.  I am not inclined to randomly waste resources in games and find this feature obnoxious when I have full health, no Triage, and a health pack in inventory.  All of the other powers appear to reload over time even if you abandon the item to use it, but Triage does not do that and I find that a serious flaw for a game otherwise very well made.

As for the leveling, it takes getting used to, but it can be worth it for unique customization when you've unlocked all the classes and traits to mix in.  I would prefer a lot more missions given how SLOW leveling your weapons and character is, but it is what it is and perhaps they plan expansion missions later?  I hope so, but honestly if they try the common BS of the industry making extra missions cost 10$ more per mission to the point you've bought a new game just to get a few more missions I may just quit playing anything by the creative team.

[h1]Too expensive and lacking [/h1]

[u]Pros:[/u]
[list]
[*]Gunplay feels nice
[*]Decent variety of alien types
[*]30 Different guns to collect and use
[*]Variety of classes with unique abilities
[*]Solid Co-op Shooter, good for a couple runs
[*]Classic guns, visuals, enemies, armour and more
[*]Some synth battles to get into for some firefights
[*]Sounds are good, gotta love that pulse rifle sound for sure
[*]Lots and lots of aliens swarming in on you (the main attraction of the game)
[*]The new Phalanx class I really like, its different and has a good feel to it, enjoying the game a bit more again since the update because of this. Close quarters weapons with a massive shield is quite fun
[/list]

[u]Neutral points:[/u]
[list]
[*]Limited to 3 player co-op, not sure of the reason but 4 players would of been better. Still, any co-op is good for me
[*]Mission length is down to people's preferences, they usually take 20-30 minutes on average and there are 12 missions in total. I personally feel the whole game is too short for the price tag
[/list]

[u]Cons:[/u]
[list]
[*]Perks are lacking and classes don't feel that unique aside from abilities
[*]Horde mode is just bad overall, Colonial Marines bug hunt was far superior
[*]Harder difficulties is simply just bullet sponge enemies with more damage output
[*]Some perks outright don't work on everything or nothing at all, some work but inconsistently
[*]Outfits and headgear is very lacking, few outfit options and headgear for the most part is ugly
[*]The AI teammates are inconsistent and usually bad, they have a tendency to get in the way of fire
[*]Aimbot lunging aliens, seriously sometimes you just dodge roll but one lacks onto you and pounces you anyway
[*]The game is mostly killing aliens, would be nice to have more synths to fight at least, other enemy types would be awesome too
[*]Basically no story whatsoever outside of talking to characters a little and collecting intel. There is some lore and such there but no effort was made for story in general
[*]Certain classes, weapons and compositions outshine the rest, you could say there is a meta. I'm not a fan of such things
[*]Matchmaking still needs work, it is still hard to find other players outside of the discord
[*]Weapon types are restricted to certain classes, only demo can use heavy weapons with the rest of the classes using a mix of close quarter weapons, pistols and rifles. The types are set for each class and cannot be changed
[*]Some class abilities need a tweak or rework, trauma station for sure. If you were hoping to play a support medic that heals the team you will be disappointed as its mostly used to slow down aliens and lacks the healing you'd assume it should have
[/list]

If you love the Alien franchise, this is a very good buy. It sticks to canon, adds some appropriate new things, and is an overall intense 3rd person shooter. 
The story mode is beaten quickly, there is currently only 1 horde level, and customization (cosmetic, mostly) options aren't ample. 
Unless you're a diehard fan, it might be worth your time to wait until they come out with more content. Otherwise if you have $40 to spare, go for it, and try to get some friends to get it with you. The AI helper bots are dumb as hell and borderline useless at Standard difficulty or higher.

Really nails the feeling of being in the Aliens universe, the sounds, weapons, locations, and music are really well done and mix it all into a great package of both fan service and a solid Division 2 meets Left 4 dead style of gameplay. Though it is rather lacking in some areas, all missions feel just like scripted moments but it's not terrible. The Horde mode you unlock later on is both good and bad, good for the fact it's a nice time waster and area to level up weapons when you don't have bonus exp cards for missions, but other than that it's one map. 

All in all it isn't a bad game, but it's one that is better with friends. I know that ♥♥♥♥ gets tossed around a lot "Just play with friends" but when playing with random teammates the only real way to communicate is with a ping system or emotes, here's hoping we got some sort of chat or voice chat system put in.

Still, I'd give it a 7.5/10, pretty solid but it needs some more work to it. Here's to more things to do.

Did you ever watch the soldiers in Alien and think "Man, I could do better then that" ?  Well, here's your chance.

This game isn't perfect, and has the normal share of new game rough spots, but the devs are active, and patches have been coming fast and furious.  If you're easily frustrated, give it a few weeks.

The game itself is an excellent squad based shooter, that is more faithful to the look and feel to the original Alien movies than the prequels were.  The level design, enemy behavior, and just overall vibe is excellent.  It does a great job of keeping you under pressure, and building ever present tension, while giving you the tools to set your worries on fire.

The story is quite well written, with a shocking level of quality voice acting.  You get to fight a large variety of foes, in a great mix of environments, and nobody at any point has to pretend to be surprised by Xeno's being badass.

Class and weapon variety feels very solid, with an in depth loadout grid system that lets you try different strategies/focuses.  The difficulty ramps up pretty harshly, with friendly fire being a major hazard.  Match making is lackluster for now, but sure to be improved.

All in all, I strongly recommend this game, if you're a fan of the franchise, or just like a tight shooter with great gameplay.
